description: This EOB holds an emergency room visit with an out-of-network emergency physician and an elective knee surgery with no prior authorization. The emergency physician's line is denied for no prior authorization, which emergency care never needs, while the surgery's denial is correct (a decoy). The expected conclusion is that the emergency physician's line should be covered with in-network cost sharing only.
